outages.cause: Rolling blackouts after attacks on energy infrastructure
outages.affected: Ukrenergo said hourly rolling blackouts of 1.5 to 3 queues (about 6–12 hours a day) are scheduled in some regions for Friday, Nov 13.

outages.cause: Generation capacity deficit (multiple thermal units offline or in maintenance)
outages.affected: 1,890 MW forecast to be affected at peak on Nov 12 (1,860 MW deficit). 1,395 MW already affected at 6:00 a.m. Cuba time Nov 12. No Nov 13 official national part found as of early Friday morning Cuba time.
outages.updated: Nov 12, 2026 (UNE morning report; no later official national part found)

outages.cause: Widespread, ongoing grid failures after years of underinvestment, worsened by June earthquakes
outages.affected: No official customer count. Bloomberg Línea reported Nov 13 that outages are worsening nationwide, with Mérida, Táchira, and Trujillo among the hardest hit; Caracas is largely spared the worst cuts.

outages.cause: National generation shortfall; Tarbela hydropower about 800 MW below normal after reduced water releases following the fifth-extension incident, plus seasonal hydrology and LNG limits
outages.affected: About 1,500 MW national shortfall during evening peak (peak demand about 16,000 MW vs. about 14,500 MW available), according to ISMO figures for Nov 11. Discos were following existing 1.5 to 2 hour load-management schedules; reports from Lahore described 3–4 hours of evening outages.
outages.updated: Nov 12, 2026; no later official ISMO update found

outages.place: Mayfair, Crosby, Reuven, and nearby suburbs
outages.cause: Fire at the Mayfair substation; the cause of the fire is being investigated
outages.affected: No official customer count. City Power said Friday morning that essential services and Crown Mines businesses have been restored, but some residents in Mayfair, Crosby, Reuven, and surrounding areas could remain without power.
outages.etr: Some customers by the weekend; full restoration could take until the end of next week or the following weekend (City Power, Nov 13)
